messages:
linda: quick check — Horizon Labs asked how uptime credits show up vs the ratecard they were shown during POC. want to align before we reply, cc @sam @raj :eyes:
sam: do we have the committed SLO in the signed docs? i recall 99.95 for prod from sales notes but legal might have pushed 99.9
raj: contract retrieval in progress. SOW A vs sales deck mismatch possible — pulling PDF now
linda: sales deck definitely mentioned 99.95 during demo. if contract says 99.9 we need to follow contract but we should be careful for renewal convo
emily: for clarity, ops uses this credit calc (standard):
```
credit = max(0, (SLO - observed_uptime) / SLO) * monthly_recurring_charge
# e.g. SLO=0.9995, observed=0.9988 -> credit_pct ~= (0.9995-0.9988)/0.9995 = 0.00070035 -> 0.07% of MRC
```
emily: note that we also cap credits per contract terms and treat partial windows per billing period
sam: can someone run an example for last month so we can show Horizon the potential exposure? @opsbot can you run uptime-agg for horizon-labs feb 1-28 and return total uptime + window breakdown?
opsbot: queued: running uptime-agg horizon-labs 2026-02-01..2026-02-28, will post results in this thread when ready :gear:
raj: if there really is a doc mismatch my recommendation: enforce SOW on billing, but offer a one-time goodwill adjustment to reflect sales messaging — documentable concession for renewal goodwill. legal ok with that flow?
linda: that sounds right. want to avoid creating precedent but also avoid churn risk during onboarding. i'll draft the customer note proposing the goodwill approach and tie it to an updated renewal quote. who will own the numbers check?
sam: i'll validate numbers. emily please export uptime dashboard + the per-window breakdown so i can run the calc and sanity-check the cap and rounding
emily: on it. will attach export link here in a minute
opsbot: results: uptime_total=99.880% for feb, windows: 99.99 (prod-1), 99.45 (prod-2, 1x 3h blip), 99.88 (overall) — estimated credit using SLO=99.95 -> ~0.07% of MRC. detailed CSV: https://redwood.internal/exports/horizon-uplift-1758888888.csv
raj: thanks. based on that, liability is small but perceptually large to customer. recommend: (1) honor 99.95 for this cycle as one-off credit, (2) update SOW for future to match contract or sales deck, (3) add a line in renewal quote explaining the correction.
linda: agreed. i'll draft note now and share w/ legal + finance for sign-off. sam/emily — please double-check numbers in the CSV and confirm rounding for the customer-facing calc. i'll route final draft to @raj for legal ok before sending
sam: will do, quick pass in next 30m
emily: exporting and sanity-checking now :white_check_mark: will post any anomalies
opsbot: export link re-post: https://redwood.internal/exports/horizon-uplift-1758888888.csv
linda: perfect. thanks all — i'll loop back with the draft in this thread shortly :v:
